visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, styled with bangs, sits at a white marble table wearing a tight white tank top and long black sheer arm warmers. Behind her, a television displays a breaking news segment, and several vintage Nintendo 64 boxes are stacked on the left, while a decorative object sits atop them. (2) A man's hand enters from the lower right, pointing toward the woman's face. She closes her eyes as the hand reaches out to touch her cheek, simulating a cleaning motion. She then opens her eyes, smiles warmly at the camera, and holds up an 'OK' hand gesture while tilting her head slightly. (3) The scene cuts to a different woman with long black hair and a ponytail, wearing a white buttoned top. She stands near a counter holding a smartphone. In the background, a red Supreme-branded arcade cabinet and a Mortal Kombat machine are visible in a dimly lit, modern interior space with gray walls.

The music maintains a constant 4/4 beat throughout this section. (3) A magical 'shimmer' or 'sparkle' sound effect triggers precisely during the hand movement on screen, coinciding with a female vocal in the music track singing 'I'm invincible'. The spectral brightness increases at this moment, emphasizing the 'magic' reveal. (4) The music continues to loop with a strong drum and bass presence as the vocal repeats, creating a sense of victory or excitement until the end of the clip.
